verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Server Pro has a management API and per-user and device-group access control. It never mentions issuing API tokens or credentials, or scoping them to least privilege for an agent or other programmatic consumer. The access-control feature governs who can reach which devices, which is related but is not the scoped API credential this story asks about. Issuing API credentials is a fair question for a self-hosted management server, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
